records.Concise description: A 10,000-piece original-art Ordinals PFP collection notable for completing inscription of its full 10k before other original-art 10k peers.
records.Deeper researched summary: NodeMonkes occupies an important place in the early large-collection chronology. Contemporary historical research distinguishes 'first original 10k to finish inscribing' from 'first original 10k to begin': Honey Badgers started earlier, while NodeMonkes completed first. The project’s public identity intentionally retained pseudonymity/enigma around its creators, so MSC should not speculate about founder identity.
Creators / founders: Pseudonymous / creator identity not reliably verified for public MSC attribution
records.Launch / history: Inscribed across early Ordinals history, with the collection range commonly documented around inscription #83,522 through #111,319; distribution/auction activity followed.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: It is a key milestone in the transition from experimental inscriptions to fully inscribed original-art 10k PFP collections.
Important technical or cultural characte: Completed full 10k inscription before other original-art 10k peers
records.Verification basis: Current official project link hub plus detailed contemporary inscription chronology.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not repeat unverified community speculation about creator identity.
Use 'first original 10k to finish inscribing,' not the broader and misleading 'first original 10k.'

records.Concise description: A Bitcoin-native art and tooling project led by lifofifo and Nicole, known for OrdRain, Nakamoto Archives, Block 78 work, recursion experiments, and Ordinals utilities.
records.Deeper researched summary: The Wizards of Ord spans multiple connected works rather than a single collection. Official project history identifies OrdRain (111 works) as a June 2023 generative/recursive experiment, Nakamoto Archives (576 works) in late 2023, and The Wizards of Ord (3,333 works on Block 78 sats) in 2024, alongside utilities and open-source components. MSC should give the umbrella project one canonical profile and model these named releases as related child entities.
records.Launch / history: OrdRain launched June 2023; Nakamoto Archives followed November 2023; 3,333 The Wizards of Ord works launched February 2024 on Block 78 sats. The ecosystem continued with tools and additional art experiments.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: It joins technically ambitious recursion/generative work with rare-sat provenance and ongoing Ordinals tooling, representing the 'art + infrastructure' side of the ecosystem.
Research notes / uncertainties: The claim that OrdRain was the first generative Ordinals collection to use recursion is a project claim; phrase it as such unless independently corroborated.
Do not create duplicate canonical pages for OrdRain/Nakamoto Archives in the initial registry.

records.Concise description: A mass Ordinals airdrop initiated by Leonidas and distributed to more than 112,000 early Ordinals wallets, later serving as the distribution bridge to the DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON Rune.
records.Deeper researched summary: Runestone used an unusually broad, no-purchase airdrop to reward early Ordinals participation. The collection comprised 112,383 recipient inscriptions plus a parent Runestone in common historical accounting (112,384 indexed collection items). After the 2024 halving, eligible Runestone holders received DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON, Rune #3, with the DOG supply distributed through that community rather than a conventional team sale. Runestone itself is now best treated as a completed historical distribution artifact; DOG continues as a separate RUNES-category entity.
records.Launch / history: Runestone airdrop executed in early 2024 to 112,000+ eligible early Ordinals addresses. DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON was subsequently launched at/after the 2024 halving and airdropped to Runestone holders.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Runestone is one of Ordinals’ largest community distributions and a direct bridge from the inscription era into the Runes ecosystem.
Important technical or cultural characte: Direct precursor/distribution mechanism for DOG Rune
records.Verification basis: Current first-party DOG/Runestone history and community documentation.
Research notes / uncertainties: Canonical DOG profile belongs in RUNES, not duplicated in ORDINALS.
Collection counts may be quoted as 112,383 distributed stones versus 112,384 including the parent; explain the distinction if a count is surfaced.

records.Concise description: A 2,111-piece wizard collection and Bitcoin advocacy project co-founded by Udi Wertheimer and Eric Wall, closely associated with efforts to revive OP_CAT.
records.Deeper researched summary: Taproot Wizards combines collectible wizard imagery with Bitcoin technical advocacy and ecosystem building. The project’s current portal lists 2,111 Taproot Wizards and 3,333 related Quantum Cats. It has used art, community campaigns, and funding initiatives to advocate for OP_CAT and broader Bitcoin scripting experimentation. MSC must distinguish that advocacy from deployment: OP_CAT’s protocol status depends on Bitcoin consensus/policy development and should never be implied by the collection itself.
records.Launch / history: The project became prominent in 2023 and expanded through 2024–2026 with the Taproot Wizards collection, Quantum Cats, OP_CAT advocacy, events, and ecosystem funding.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: It is one of the clearest examples of an Ordinals-native cultural project using collectibles as a vehicle for Bitcoin technical advocacy and developer ecosystem formation.
records.Verification basis: Current Taproot Wizards portal/site and active first-party channels.
Research notes / uncertainties: Older sale materials sometimes cite 2,121; current official portal lists 2,111. Use the current portal count and retain discrepancy internally.
Never state OP_CAT is activated merely because the project advocates it.
